## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 4 oct 2026 - 5 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Valentin Lopez_, 5 oct 2026, 1/5: "App not working just keeps refreshing. Paid a subscription for nothing if it doesn't work."
            2. _leslie cowan_, 4 oct 2026, 1/5: "I canceled the trial, but was still charged"
            3. _Lucienne Dadouch_, 5 oct 2026, 2/5: "upgraded to premium but can't log in with my google account (premium account). Annoying."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 may 2026 - 5 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _James Steward_, 5 oct 2026, 1/5: "App constantly freezing after modying daily entries. Regular popups prompting to subscribe whenever the app is opened. Dozens of duplicates of food items with incorrect macros, no proper administration done to ensure entries are correct."
            2. _Thorsten Mootz_, 30 ago 2026, 1/5: "Neues Update ist ganz schlimm und benutzerunfreundlich. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
            3. _Harun_, 4 ago 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
